name: MRO HUD · Settings
author: OpenRevo Community
description: [Note] This plugin must be installed together with the "MRO HUD" main plugin; installed on its own, the settings page cannot take effect and full functionality is unavailable. Please download the other plugin as well. [MRO HUD settings page] Four backgrounds - dark / glass / flat / transparent - with background opacity and text opacity fully independent, plus overall size, always-on-top, the 1% Low display and its statistics window, with a live preview and FPS / frametime / 1% Low readings. Changes are written to mro-hud\settings.ini and the HUD syncs once a second. Requires the companion "MRO HUD" main plugin to be running.
